Never use social media when depressed, even if you want to stay connected with family or friends, social media is a depressant.

I have found solace in sharing my story with a select few people I have actual trust in. I know there are no answers and no relief for my condition, but I dont let that fact dictate my choices. I acknowledge the fact and make effort to endure despite the fact.

I hope you can find the willpower to be yourself again, I say this because we are not simply our symptoms, we are capable of anything of we want and finding that willpower is not out of our reach, it is simply a door we keep closed out of fear, anxiety or despair.
